g.title: PIBOT_YM
g.text: No pin labels on the board. Pins 1-4 are 2B, 2A, 1A, 1B:
one coil on the two screws at each end.

g.title: NEMA17_Y
g.text: Coils: black-blue and green-red, about 3.6 ohm each.

g.title: PIBOT_ZM
g.text: No pin labels on the board. Pins 1-4 are 2B, 2A, 1A, 1B:
one coil on the two screws at each end.

g.title: NEMA17_Z
g.text: Coils: black-blue and green-red, about 3.6 ohm each.
